skill.description: Build, test, and prepare ChatGPT Apps with the Apps SDK, MCP servers, widgets, OAuth, deployment, and submission guidance.

security_audit.summary: Manual adjudication found that most static hits are false positives from TypeScript template literals, documentation examples, local build files, and defensive blocklists. Confirmed risks are limited to security-sensitive template behavior: wildcard CORS on MCP endpoints, API token forwarding to configured backends, and external image fetching that needs redirect-aware validation. No prompt injection evidence was found in the reviewed skill text.

remediation.suggestion: Restrict Access-Control-Allow-Origin to trusted ChatGPT and deployment origins, and reject unexpected Origin headers before processing SSE or message requests.

remediation.issue: Bearer token sent to configurable API host
remediation.suggestion: Require an explicit trusted API_BASE_URL, document allowlist checks, and avoid sending API_TOKEN when placeholder or untrusted hosts are configured.
Use manual redirect handling or revalidate every redirect target against HTTPS, internal-address, and domain whitelist rules before fetching image bytes.

remediation.issue: Template security depends on user customization
remediation.suggestion: Add a pre-deployment checklist that requires replacing placeholders, reviewing CSP and security headers, validating input schemas, and limiting response sizes.

content.value_statement: ChatGPT App projects require fit checks, MCP design, widget work, testing, and submission preparation. This skill gives agents a structured workflow and reusable templates for building them.
actual_capabilities: Evaluates whether a product fits ChatGPT App use cases using Know, Do, Show criteria.
Creates an app specification with tools, widget needs, authentication, and golden prompts.
Guides MCP server implementation with SSE routes, tool handlers, and resource templates.
Provides widget patterns for React, layout height updates, state, and ChatGPT bridge APIs.
Covers OAuth setup, local testing, deployment, and App Store submission checklists.
limitations: It does not guarantee OpenAI App Store approval.
It requires the user to supply product details, APIs, credentials, and test data.
Generated templates need security review before production deployment.
Current platform rules may require checking official OpenAI documentation.

use_cases.title: Evaluate Product Fit
use_cases.description: Decide whether a product should become a ChatGPT App before engineering work starts.

use_cases.title: Build an MCP Prototype
use_cases.description: Build a local MCP server, widget, tools, and tests from a written app specification.

use_cases.title: Prepare Launch Requirements
use_cases.description: Prepare OAuth, deployment, connector testing, and submission requirements for launch.

prompt_templates.title: Evaluate App Fit
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate whether [product] should become a ChatGPT App. Ask clarifying questions, assess Know, Do, Show value, list blockers, and recommend next steps.

prompt_templates.title: Draft App Specification
prompt_templates.prompt: Use my product details to draft app-spec.md. Include tools, widget needs, auth model, golden prompts, data boundaries, and testing criteria.

prompt_templates.title: Build Starter App
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a starter ChatGPT App from this app-spec.md. Generate server routes, tool handlers, widget files, package scripts, and local run steps.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Launch Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this ChatGPT App for OAuth, security headers, CORS, widget behavior, golden prompts, deployment readiness, and submission gaps.

output_examples.input: Evaluate a project management product for ChatGPT.
output_examples.output: Fit summary with Know, Do, Show scoring, app blockers, required APIs, and recommended golden prompts.

output_examples.input: Plan the implementation for my app specification.
output_examples.output: Project structure summary, MCP tool list, widget behavior plan, local testing sequence, and deployment checklist.

output_examples.input: Prepare this app for submission review.
output_examples.output: Readiness report covering OAuth endpoints, privacy and terms pages, mobile widget behavior, test credentials, and reviewer notes.

best_practices: Start with fit evaluation and golden prompts before writing code.
Keep each MCP tool focused on one clear user action or query.
Review generated templates for auth, CORS, input validation, and data limits before deployment.
anti_patterns: Do not build a ChatGPT App before confirming it has clear Know, Do, or Show value.
Do not combine unrelated operations into one broad tool with vague descriptions.
Do not deploy generated templates without replacing placeholders and reviewing security defaults.

faq.question: What does this skill help build?
faq.answer: It helps plan, scaffold, test, deploy, and submit ChatGPT Apps that use the Apps SDK and MCP.

faq.question: Does it remove the need for engineering work?
faq.answer: No. It provides workflow guidance and templates, but users still need to connect real APIs and review code.

faq.question: Can it help with OAuth?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes OAuth integration guidance, but production setup still needs provider-specific configuration.

faq.question: Can it test apps inside ChatGPT?
faq.answer: It guides local MCP Inspector tests, HTTPS tunnel setup, connector creation, and golden prompt validation.

faq.question: Does it guarantee App Store approval?
faq.answer: No. It helps prepare a submission, but OpenAI review decisions and current policies still apply.

faq.question: Which coding agents can use it?
faq.answer: It is marked for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code, and works best with filesystem-capable agents.
